card.name: Words just before a time span
card.fires_on: Small words or number slots right before an expected duration or time interval, such as 'over' before 20 to 30 years, 'every' before 2 months, or 'at' before 48 to 72 hours.

modes.label: Link word before duration
modes.description: A preposition or similar word that leads into a length of time.
modes.example: chronic HCV leads to cirrhosis in 20% of patients<< over>> 20 to 30 years

modes.label: Slot before a number of hours or days
modes.description: The space or number just before a time value, in dosing or testing schedules.
modes.example: Insert a single SCENESSE implant subcutaneously above the anterior supra-iliac crest every<< >>2 months.

modes.label: Dose-interval phrasing
modes.description: Words in a repeat-dose schedule just before the interval.
modes.example: 550 mg followed by 550<< mg>> every 12 hours or 2

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying 'time', 'time period', or 'elapsed' for durations.
card.plain: It fires on the word or gap just before a length of time, like 'every' or 'over' ahead of hours, days or years.
